title: a wide establishing view of a misty mountain range at dawn with a sword sect's pale gate and temple roofs tiny on a distant ridge, a lone silver flying sword far away in the sky, layered teal ridges
tong_mon: a sword sect courtyard on a misty mountain at morning: pale stone plaza, dark teal tiled roofs, cinnabar red pillars, pink peach blossom trees, pine forest on the slopes, a few tiny disciples practicing sword forms far away
thung_lung: a quiet green mountain valley with a winding dirt path, scattered grey boulders, wildflowers, a small stream and low drifting mist, pine slopes on both sides
suoi_thanh_khe: a clear shallow mountain stream tumbling over mossy stones between bamboo and young pines, morning mist over the water, soft sunlight shafts
rung_linh_thao: a dense ancient forest of pine and maple with shafts of golden sunlight through the canopy, spirit herbs with faintly glowing jade-green leaves on the forest floor, thick low mist
vach_da_ngoc: a tall pale jade-colored rock cliff wall rising from a rocky shelf, streaks of green-white jade in the stone, a thin waterfall far on one side, hanging mist at the base
ho_suong_mu: a calm misty lake at dawn, still mirror water reflecting teal mountains, thick white mist drifting over the surface, a shoreline of pale pebbles and reeds, a faint pale sun low on the horizon
kiem_trung: a vast stone basin graveyard of ancient swords: thousands of rusted and weathered swords planted blade-down in grey earth, a broken stone gate arch, cold teal mist and faint pale-blue glints on some blades, a low golden dawn sun
